title: macOS Native Window Runtime Reliability Corrective

platformApplicability.Windows: N/A — defect and corrective ownership are specific to the macOS JXA/Cocoa/WKWebView adapter; shared product/domain behavior is unchanged
platformApplicability.Web: N/A — defect and corrective ownership are specific to the macOS native-window adapter; shared product/domain behavior is unchanged

scope: Correct the reproducible macOS native-window startup failure caused by formal NSApplicationDelegate protocol-name resolution in the JXA Objective-C bridge.

Retain the existing NSObject delegate selectors and NSApplication delegate assignment while removing the unnecessary formal protocol declaration that fails with 'protocol does not exist (-2700)' on the exercised macOS 15 Apple Silicon runtime.
Preserve the existing Go backend, local HTTP serving, WKWebView content, SQLite persistence, user state and API-key continuity; no reset/delete-first remediation is allowed.
Harden the canonical macOS package audit so the exact extracted package executes the real JXA/Cocoa/WKWebView window path rather than only a headless backend launch.
Require canonical bundle executable identity: CFBundleExecutable=DePulseLauncher, executable DePulse-arm64 present, and legacy Contents/MacOS/De-Pulse absent from the certified artifact.
Prove fresh native startup, bounded startup dwell, orderly test cleanup and warm relaunch against the same persisted profile on Apple Silicon.
Bind the actual packaged native-window lifecycle proof into the existing macOS WebKit qualification path and existing G13/G14 package owner; do not create a parallel workflow or packaging subsystem.
acceptance: Full exact-head Qualified passes, including backend, renderer, Chrome and WebKit lanes required by the impact plan.
Actual packaged macOS backend health/readiness/root and SQLite integrity/migrations pass.
Actual packaged non-headless JXA/Cocoa/WKWebView child remains alive through the startup dwell on a fresh profile.
The same exact package warm-relaunches successfully using the same persisted profile.
native-window.log contains no 'protocol does not exist (-2700)' startup failure and no immediate native-window error exit.
No user state/API-key deletion or silent fatal-error masking is introduced.
Canonical G11-G16 release flow remains the only promotion path; merge/release requires explicit authorization.
outOfScope: No coverage-aware Smart Provider Router work.
No company/instrument identity, Market Data Modes, provider observability, Form 4, ticker search, movers/ranking or other provider expansion.
No Windows or Web feature work beyond proving their shared-domain non-impact through normal regression qualification.
No new provider, router, cache, persistence, scanner, scheduler, SEC, Market Mode or native-window subsystem.
No Execution, paper trading, order routing, P&L, portfolio or journal features.

No claim that the canonical JXA exit-status-1 reproduction is the same signature as the original SIGABRT report from a legacy/non-canonical Contents/MacOS/De-Pulse executable without matching crash evidence.
rollback: Before merge, revert the v18.9.1 branch commits if actual packaged lifecycle qualification disproves the corrective behavior.
After any authorized release, rollback means reinstalling the immutable prior Stable artifact while preserving the PersonalMarketTerminal data directory; never roll back by deleting user state.
If a new native error appears, fail qualification and isolate the exact native adapter statement before further correction.
permanentBoundaries: Smart Provider Router v2 is sole provider-routing authority
Canonical freshness/recovery and persistence/state owners remain unchanged
Deterministic Day/Swing/Long market truth remains protected
